WITH o AS ( SELECT Timestamp, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM Timestamp) AS mo, DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) AS doy_omni, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM Timestamp) <= 2 THEN DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) + 1 ELSE DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) END AS doy_2024 FROM OMNI2 WHERE Timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01' AND Timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01') SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mo > 2 AND doy_2024 - doy_omni <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_bad, MIN(CASE WHEN mo > 2 AND doy_2024 - doy_omni <> 1 THEN mo END) AS month_of_bad_min, MAX(CASE WHEN mo > 2 AND doy_2024 - doy_omni <> 1 THEN mo END) AS month_of_bad_max, SUM(CASE WHEN mo > 2 AND doy_2024 - doy_omni <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_sample_bad_rows FROM o

WITH o AS ( SELECT Timestamp, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM Timestamp) AS mo, DAYOFYEAR(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + (DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1) * INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS doy_mapped FROM OMNI2 WHERE Timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01' AND Timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2016-04-01') SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN doy_mapped <> DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_bad, SUM(CASE WHEN doy_mapped = DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_ok_mar, COUNT(*) AS n_rows_mar, SUM(doy_mapped - (DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1)) AS sum_ts_doy_minus_dd_doy FROM o

SELECT TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + 74 * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS ts_val, CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + 74 * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE) AS as_date, DAYOFYEAR(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + 74 * INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS doy_ts, DAYOFYEAR(CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + 74 * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS DATE)) AS doy_date, CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + 74 * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS VARCHAR) AS epoch_str

SELECT DAYOFYEAR(TIMESTAMP '2024-03-15 00:00:00' + INTERVAL 0 DAY) AS m1, DAYOFYEAR(TIMESTAMP '2024-03-15 00:00:00' + INTERVAL 0 DAY + INTERVAL 0 HOUR) AS m2, EXTRACT(DOY FROM TIMESTAMP '2024-03-15 00:00:00') AS m3

WITH o AS ( SELECT Timestamp, DAYOFYEAR(CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + (DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1) * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS TIMESTAMP)) AS doy_mapped FROM OMNI2 WHERE Timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01' AND Timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2016-04-01') SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN doy_mapped <> DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_bad, COUNT(*) AS n_rows_mar_2016, SUM(CASE WHEN doy_mapped = DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_ok, MIN(doy_mapped) AS sample_doy_mapped FROM o

WITH o AS ( SELECT Timestamp, DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) AS doy_src, DAYOFYEAR(CAST(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' + (DAYOFYEAR(Timestamp) - 1) * INTERVAL 1 DAY AS TIMESTAMP)) AS doy_mapped FROM OMNI2 WHERE Timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2016-01-01' AND Timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01') SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (doy_src > 60) AND (doy_mapped <> doy_src - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_bad, COUNT(*) AS n_total, SUM(CASE WHEN (doy_src > 60) AND (doy_mapped = doy_src - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_ok FROM o

WITH t AS (SELECT '2024-03-15' AS input_str) SELECT input_str, TRY_CAST(input_str AS DATE) AS parsed, DAYOFYEAR(TRY_CAST(input_str AS DATE)) AS doy_out FROM t UNION ALL SELECT '2024-03-15 00:00:00', TRY_CAST('2024-03-15 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP), DAYOFYEAR(TRY_CAST('2024-03-15 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) UNION ALL SELECT '2024-03-15', TRY_CAST('2024-03-15' AS TIMESTAMP), DAYOFYEAR(TRY_CAST('2024-03-15' AS TIMESTAMP))
